_comment: Copy to .mcp.json (gitignored) and replace the <...> placeholders. PERL_ROOT is the portable Strawberry Perl root; PERL_HOME is derived by scripts/profile.ps1 as its perl\ subdirectory. MCP_POWERSHELL_PROFILE must point at this checkout's scripts/profile.ps1. CDXSCI_ROOT belongs in scripts/local.psd1 or this env block. Keep .codex/config.toml and .grok/config.toml in agreement by hand. pwsh_exec command is the owned CPython under mcp/pwsh_exec/deps/python (restore writes the concrete path); uv.exe is restore-only. Do not copy generic tool_timeout_sec onto this server: LaTeXAI waits live in the child scripts.
